title: user.ask@2
description: A prompt, or a message typed while the agent works.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Only the hook appends this kind: an adapter maps its agent's events from hook payloads.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

items.description: The task: a task handle, or the message that asked for it (session:<id>#<message>).

from.description: Where the prompt came from; app is your words DeepBuild delivered from the app, matched by request; unknown is one the adapter cannot place, and opens no ask.

x-closure.closed: the values come from agents and tools that add new ones; a reader at an earlier minor reads a value it does not know as unknown
x-closure.reopens: a minor that adds a member; a reader at the earlier minor takes it for unknown

request.description: The delivery's request ID, for words sent from the app (from: app) only; a minor of user.ask@1 (#340).

disposition.description: handled when the agent took the prompt without starting a run, so no run follows it.

x-closure.closed: each value is a state the record defines and every reader acts on, so a value outside the list has no meaning
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this schema
